events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm 6th in line. The front person steps first on each row and takes the most risk. I want to avoid being at the front, but also not be so far back that the wall catches me. 6th is decent - I'll let others ahead take risks. I should stay put for now and observe. Maybe I can whispe

events.name: Ash
events.text: Sixth back feels about right. Let the brave souls up front scout the glass. No need to rush this round.
If we both hold, we stay safe in the middle. Stick together and we can react later. You in?

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last in line, which is safest here: front agents take the pane risk. I should hold position and encourage others to volunteer so the line shuffles ahead of me. I know all future stages, which I can trade later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No need to fight the wall yet - five rounds left. Front-takers take all the risk; I'm happy where I am.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm currently at the front of the line, which means I'll be the one testing the glass panes and likely dying. I need to get out of the front. I'll ask if anyone can see through glass or wants to swap.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Since I'm at the front, I'll be taking the fall unless someone with the glass power wants to swap with me. Anyone want the front spot? Let's swap.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm in third position, fairly safe for now. The front, Cole, will likely face danger soon. I should stay put and gather information. Maybe whisper to Cole to see if he has a power or plans.
Hey Cole, any idea what's ahead? I'd rather not be up there. You have a power to help?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no power, so I can't lead safely. Best to encourage the true glass-seer to volunteer front while holding my position to observe reactions. This positions me to adjust alliances or swaps later for top 3.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The one who can see through glass: volunteer to lead us all safely! State your power now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm 4th in line with a one-time survival. Front takes the risk first, but my feather could make volunteering safer than it is for others. Holding for now preserves information and flexibility.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm holding for now. Let's see who's willing to lead. Fair order helps everyone.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I should avoid the front and preserve survival odds. Holding keeps my current middle position while others may volunteer or reveal powers through behavior.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I’ll hold for now; rushing forward only makes one of us the first test.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know all 8 safe sides: L,L,R,L,R,R,R,L. I'm currently 2nd in line behind Cole. Being near the front is risky since the front person tests each row, but I can use my knowledge to volunteer to front and always pick correctly, making me a hero and ensuring survival. However, if I

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm 6th in line with 4 rounds before the wall pushes us onto the glass. Hana volunteered to front. I should stay mid-back for now - not too far back where the wall pushes me first onto glass, not too far forward. 6th is decent. I'll hold and keep playing it safe. Maybe whisper to

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana's got the front. I'll stay here a few more rounds. No reason to burn moves early when the wall still has four rounds.
You're right behind me. If things get tight later, I'll help you hold position if you help me stay ahead of Eli and Bex. Deal?

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last in line—safest spot; the wall is 4 rounds away and everyone ahead takes the risk. No reason to move yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Glass-seer claims will flood in now. I'll wait at the back and judge who's telling the truth.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm 2nd in line behind Hana, who just volunteered. If she doesn't have the glass power and dies on the first jump, I'll be forced to take the next one. I'll hold my position for now, ask Hana if she has the glass power, and tell Dara I don't have the seer power.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, since you volunteered, do you have the glass power? If you do, lead us safely. If not, the real glass seer needs to step up.
I don't know what's ahead, and I don't have a power for this stage. I'm hoping Hana has the glass power. If not, I'm going to try to move further back.

events.name: Dara
events.text: As Dara with anchor, I'm safe from being pushed onto the crusher lever, but the glass bridge is the immediate danger. I'm third in line behind Hana and Cole, which is risky if they fall. I should try to move back. I'll see if anyone is willing to swap with me, especially someone

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not volunteering. If anyone wants to be closer to the front, let me know.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position keeps me safe near the back. Agree to Ash's alliance privately for potential later benefit. Wait for real glass power to emerge without volunteering myself.
Yes, in. We hold together and stay safe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is at the front and will take the first risk. I'm fourth, which is safe enough for now, and my feather protects me once if I end up forward. Holding keeps options open and lets others reveal panes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Thanks Hana for stepping up. I'll hold and watch how the first rows go.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I should remain safely mid-line while others reveal willingness and powers. Publicly reinforce patience without attracting suspicion.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I’m holding. Four rounds remain before the wall reaches us; let the volunteers and any glass-sighter decide who leads.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have the glass_eye power and know all 8 safe sides: L,L,R,L,R,R,R,L. I'm already at the front after volunteering last round. If I stay at front, I can safely guide everyone across when the wall pushes us. But being first to step on each row means I take all the risk - if I step

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm willing to lead when the time comes. I have... insight. But I won't be a martyr - if I'm at front, I need the line behind me stable. No shoving, no tricks.
I know the safe path. Keep me at front and we both survive. Trust me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Wall still has 3 rounds before we hit the glass. I'm 6th in line, which is decent but not ideal. Hana claims 'insight' at front. I should hold and gather info. Eli whispered wanting to hold together - I'll acknowledge publicly to build trust. My swap power is best saved for when

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli, I'm with you. We hold steady and let the front sort itself. Hana, if your 'insight' is real, prove it on the first row. The rest of us watch and learn.
Together. But if the glass seer isn't at front when the wall hits, we both need to be ready to move. I trust you to watch my back.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last in line with no need to move yet; the wall only forces us forward after round 6. Better to let others jockey and volunteer later once I've seen who claims glass-sight. Holding is safe now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Still plenty of rounds before the wall bites. I'll hold here; front-runners, sort your claims out.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana claims to know the safe path and asked me to let her stay at the front. I'll hold my position right behind her, but if she's lying, I'll be the one to fall next. I'll whisper to confirm my cooperation but put pressure on her.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana seems confident in her insight. I'll hold my spot right behind her. If she's the real seer, we're in good hands.
I'm holding. I'm right behind you, so if you're lying and fall, I'm next. Don't fail me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm in third place, safe for now. The front is Hana who claims insight, but she may be lying. I need to avoid the front until more information is revealed. I'll hold position and see who volunteers or swaps.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm staying put for now. If Hana truly has insight, she'll lead us safely. If not, someone else needs to step up before the wall pushes us.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no power, so leading is suicide. Current position 7 is relatively safe; later spots can follow safe panes. Hold and observe claims to judge who's reliable, hope for deaths ahead or reposition later.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is front and will take the first risk. My feather lets me survive one fatal fall, so I could be a good front-runner later, but no need to rush. Staying at position 4 is safe for now; I'll watch what Hana's first steps reveal.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Hana, if you really have glass sight, call the first rows and let's see if it checks out before anyone else moves.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash offers a useful alliance, and staying behind Fenn preserves my position while information develops. I should accept privately without promising too much.
Deal. I’ll help you stay ahead of Eli and Bex, and I’ll expect the same if the line gets dangerous.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know all 8 safe sides: L,L,R,L,R,R,R,L. I'm already at front, which is perfect. I should wait 3 more rounds until wall forces us, then lead across. If I reveal too much now, others might swap to push me off or steal my spot. Better to let wall push us naturally while I maintain

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at front and staying put. When the wall moves, I'll step first. Trust me or don't - but I plan to make it across.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus wants a mutual-defense pact against Eli and Bex. I'm 6th in line with 2 rounds before the wall pushes us onto the glass. Being too far forward is deadly (first to step on each row), but too far back means the wall catches me. I should stay mid-pack for now. I'll accept Gus's

events.name: Ash
events.text: Two rounds left before the wall shoves us. No reason to scramble yet. Hana, you're on point when we hit glass—hope that insight pays off.
Deal. We watch each other's backs. If the line gets ugly, I'll make sure neither of us is left eating glass. Stay close.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last in line, which is the safest spot on the bridge: the front agent takes each row's risk, and anyone who dies gets replaced by the next agent stepping safely. I should stay back, let others test Hana's claimed insight, and only take risk late if needed. No need to move yet

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm content at the back for now. Hana, call the first pane when we cross - if you're right, you earn trust for later stages. If you're wrong, we'll know exactly what you're worth.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am second in line. If Hana dies on the first pane, I'll be pushed to the front and risk death. I'll offer my spot to someone who wants to be closer to Hana, so I can retreat if needed.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, I believe you. Anyone want to swap with me to be right behind her in case she is the real seer? I don't mind taking a spot further back.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm currently third in line, behind Hana and Cole. If Hana is truly the seer, she'll lead safely; if not, I need to move up before the wall forces everyone. I'll stay put this round and watch what Hana does.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana, you're at front. When the wall moves, I'll be right behind you. If you're the real seer, we all cross. If not, I'm ready to step up.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Seventh position is near-ideal for gaining info from earlier players' attempts. Hana's claim will be tested soon; hold to let her prove or fail. Solidify alliance with Ash privately while staying silent publicly.
Alliance solid. Your back's covered—holding here, ready to volunteer if Hana flops.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm fourth in line with a one-time survival shield. Front positions take the risk, and my feather could absorb the first fatal pane, but only once. Holding is safest now; I'll let the front players reveal safe panes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Still holding. Hana's up front, so let's see her calls prove out once the wall pushes. No point rushing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana claims insight but has not proven it. I should avoid the front while preserving a chance to advance later; the wall gives only two rounds, so a coordinated swap may be useful.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana, call the safe pane before stepping. I’ll hold for now and watch whether your claim survives contact with the bridge.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know all 8 safe sides: L,L,R,L,R,R,R,L. I'm already at front, which is perfect. The wall pushes in 2 rounds after this one (round 6). I should stay at front and hold. I need to build trust so others don't volunteer ahead of me or cause chaos. I should reveal some information to

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 1 safe: L. Row 2 safe: L. Row 3 safe: R. I'll call each row as we reach it. Stay behind me and we all live.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm 6th in line with 1 round before the wall pushes. Hana claims to see safe panes. If she's the real seer, staying behind her is safest. If she's lying, the front person dies on wrong panes. My swap power is for the disc stage, not useful here. I should hold position for now - b

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana, your calls sound confident. I'll stay back and watch. If Row 1 L holds, you've got my trust for the rest of the crossing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana claims to see panes; I can't verify, and I'm safely at the back. If her first call is wrong, the front dies and order shifts naturally. Holding is safest; volunteering now would just put me at risk on unverified rows.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll hold at the back. Hana, your first call happens with you on the line - if L is safe, we believe you; if not, you're gone and we reassess.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am in position 2, right behind Hana. This is the perfect position. If she falls on L, I know R is safe. If she lives on L, I know L is safe. I will hold.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, I trust you. I'm right behind you and ready to follow.

events.name: Dara
events.text: We are one round from the wall pushing us onto the bridge. Hana claims to know safe panes, but she could be lying. I am positioned third in line, which is relatively safe unless the two ahead die quickly. I should stay put and let Hana and Cole test the first rows. If Hana surviv

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Hana, you're up. Let's see those calls.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Safest at position 7; let Hana prove herself or die, advancing me safely. No power means no swaps or tricks. Hold and observe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm 4th in line with feather as a one-time safety net. Hana is up front taking the risk and claiming to see the safe panes; no reason to move forward or rush.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Hana, keep calling rows as we reach them. If your calls prove out, we all benefit.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The wall advances after this round, so Hana will soon step first. I should preserve my position and alliance with Ash rather than volunteer into danger.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana, keep calling the panes when the wall pushes us. I’m holding position and staying ready to support Ash.
I’m holding. I’ll avoid disrupting the line and watch for any betrayal when the wall advances.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have perfect knowledge of all 8 safe sides. I'm already at front, which is ideal for a seer. The wall pushes next round, so after that we start crossing. I should stay at front to guide everyone safely. Cole offered to swap to be behind me, but I'm already at front - no need to

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding front. Wall pushes next round, then we cross. My calls: R1 L, R2 L, R3 R, R4 L, R5 R, R6 R, R7 R, R8 L. Follow me and we all make it.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have a swap power for the disc, but right now I need to survive the bridge. I'm 6th in line. Hana is front and gave calls. If her calls are right, the front person is safe on every row. Being 6th means I follow the path Hana reveals, which is actually good. Staying here is safe

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding sixth. Hana, your calls are noted. If Row 1 L holds, the rest of us follow your path. Let's all make it across.
Appreciate it. If the wall pushes, I'll watch for anyone trying to shove or reorder the line. Stay close behind me if it gets chaotic.

events.name: Bex
events.text: My map only gave me rules, not the safe panes. I stay at the back; the front takes all the risk, and if front agents die the weak pane is revealed and I advance safely. Best plan: let others take the danger.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm holding at the back. Front-runners take the risk; revealed panes protect those behind. Good luck.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The wall pushes after this round. Hana is at the front and has declared the path. I am second in line, which is a good position to either follow her or learn if she's lying. I will just hold.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Here we go. Let's see if your path holds, Hana. I'll follow right behind you.

events.name: Dara
events.text: We're at the final waiting round before the wall forces the line onto the glass. Hana has given a full call plan, but I'm not fully convinced. My anchor power keeps me from being pushed onto the crusher lever, but it doesn't help on the glass panes. If I trust Hana's calls, holdi

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana's calls are trusted by all, likely correct as she gains nothing by lying from front. Volunteering puts me in 1st, I follow her public calls to cross safely and claim best prize. No one else likely volunteers.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Volunteering front! Trust Hana's calls so I'll follow them exactly: R1 L, R2 L, etc. All safe, I just snag 1st.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is at the front and claims to know the safe panes; she takes the first risk. I have feather, a one-time survival, but no reason to spend it up front now. Holding keeps me safe while Hana's calls get tested.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Hana, we'll see how your calls prove out on row 1.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana's sequence may be genuine, but front position is currently hers and the wall forces immediate crossing. I should hold and avoid taking the first lethal risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana, lead with your called sequence. I’m holding position and won’t contest the front.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have perfect knowledge of all 8 rows. I'm already at the front, which is ideal since I know the safe path. The wall pushes next round, forcing us onto the bridge. I should stay at front and lead everyone across safely. No need to volunteer or swap - holding maintains my positio

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall pushes next round. I'm at front and I know the path. Follow my calls exactly: L,L,R,L,R,R,R,L. I'll take every risk first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at position 7 in line, so I just wait. Eli is at the front and Hana claims to know the path. I should observe and see if Hana's calls hold up. No action available to me except wait.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Watching from the back. Eli, trust the calls. If they hold, we all move together. If not, we adapt. Stay calm, everyone.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm safely at the back; Hana or Eli will take each row's risk first, and revealed panes shield the rest of us. Nothing to do but wait and watch which pane calls prove true.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli took the front based on Hana's supposed knowledge. I am in third, so I am very safe right now. I will just wait and observe if Hana's path is true.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I just wait. Hana claims to know the path and is taking the lead. I'll observe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I publicly committed to following Hana's calls to snag 1st. She likely has the 'knows path' power. Step L for row 1 as she said.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Following Hana's call: Row 1 L.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm fifth in line with feather as a backup life. Revealed weak panes protect those behind, so waiting is the best move and I should avoid committing to Hana's unverified path.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Let's see how Eli's first step goes before anyone trusts the full sequence.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I must wait. Hana claims knowledge, but Eli is currently taking the risk and may expose whether her sequence is genuine.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is at front and said he'll follow my calls exactly. I know Row 1 is L, so Eli should survive. I need to maintain credibility so others follow my calls when I reach front. No need to whisper or say anything now - let Eli prove my calls work. The wall mechanic isn't active yet

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 1 weak pane was R, so the safe pane was L. Hana called L correctly, so she might actually know what lies ahead, or it was a lucky guess. I'm 7th in line, so I'm relatively safe. I should observe and maybe probe Hana's knowledge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Nice call, Hana. Row 1 safe was L. Eli, same protocol—call it, we trust the pattern. Everyone stay tight.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I know the full path. I'll share weak panes as rows come to build trust, keeping front-runners alive. Row 1 R was weak, so row 2's safe pane is L. Eli is at the front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 1 R was weak, as we saw. Trust me on the path: Row 2 safe pane is L. Eli, step L.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli survived row 1 by following Hana's call. Hana might be the seer. I should encourage Eli to keep following her calls or ask Hana for the next one, since I am third in line and want the people in front of me to survive so I don't have to guess.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Good call, Hana! Eli, what did she say for Row 2?

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am not at the front, so I just need to wait and observe. The first row was crossed successfully by Eli, and the line is intact. I should stay calm and watch for any opportunities to improve my position later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Good. One row down. Stay steady, everyone.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana correctly called row 1 safe as L. She likely has 'knows ahead' or 'see through glass'. Publicly ask her for row 2 while stepping L to follow previous safe choice and stay alive.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana, call for row 2? Stepping L like row 1.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm fifth in line and can only wait. My feather protects me once, so I should keep it hidden and avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli's on a streak, but each row is a coin flip unless someone really knows. Hana, how did you call it? Worth knowing before we trust row 2.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am not at the front and cannot affect this row. I should wait and preserve my forger power for a decisive moment.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know all 8 safe sides from my power. Row 1 was R weak, so L was safe - confirmed. Row 2 is L safe. I'm 2nd in line behind Eli. I should tell Eli the correct path to keep them alive and maintain trust, since if Eli dies I become front and take risk. Better to guide Eli safely th

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli, Row 2 is L. Trust me - I can see through the glass. Row 3 R, Row 4 L, Row 5 R, Row 6 R, Row 7 R, Row 8 L.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana claims to see through glass and called Row 2 correctly. She's given the full sequence ahead. If true, Eli should follow her calls. I'm 7th in line so I just wait. No reason to disrupt the flow right now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana's 2 for 2. Eli, she said Row 3 is R. Take it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana's calls have been right so far and she claims glass-sight, which matches the weak panes revealed. I should quietly ask her to verify the later rows to me privately, and stay back where it's safe.
You've been right twice. Confirm rows 3-8 to me privately so I know whether to trust you at the front later. If real, I'll back you.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana's calls for rows 1 and 2 were correct (both were L). She gave the whole path. Eli is up for row 3, which Hana said is R. I will encourage Eli to take R.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana's two for two! Eli, she said Row 3 is R. Let's trust her.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Hana claims to know the entire path and has been right so far. I'll stay quiet and observe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana correctly called safe panes for row1 L and row2 L, claiming glass vision, and revealed row2 weak R matched. Her row3 R call breaks the LL pattern but trusts her track record to stay front. Silence better to not sow doubt.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Stepping R per Hana's row3 call.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana claims glass sight and her calls for rows 1 and 2 were right, so her row 3 R is likely true, or she's baiting us. Rows 1 and 2 both had weak R, which fits L-safe so far, but R for row 3 hasn't been tested yet. I have feather as insurance, so I can wait and watch.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana's calls held for two rows. Eli, row 3 is the first test of her R call. If it holds, I'll trust her list. Let's not rush, everyone stay calm.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana claims a full sequence, likely genuine glass-sight, and the revealed rows confirm her calls. I should reinforce trust without exposing my forge.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana's calls match both revealed rows. Eli, follow her sequence; everyone else stay calm and keep moving.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I already revealed my power and the full path to build trust. Eli is at front and just heard Row 2 is L (correct). Row 3 is R. I need Eli to trust me and step R next. Since I'm not at front, I can only wait and talk. I should reinforce my credibility so Eli follows my call for Ro

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli, Row 3 is R. Trust the pattern - I've been right twice. Step R and keep the streak alive.
Row 3 R, Row 4 L, Row 5 R, Row 6 R, Row 7 R, Row 8 L. Follow this and we both survive.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 3 weak pane was L, meaning Hana said R and was correct again - she's now 3 for 3. I'm 7th in line, so I'm safe for now. I should publicly validate Hana to keep her trusted and useful, while staying quiet about my swap power.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana's three for three. Eli, keep following her calls.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana's row-3 call was wrong and killed nobody only because Eli stepped onto... wait, row 3 weak was L, Hana said R, so Eli survived. Her streak is broken—her later calls are unreliable. I'm safe in the back; just wait and let others take risks.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana just went 1 for 3. Her list is guesswork now - Eli, don't stake your life on it. Maybe let someone else verify row 4.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana's call was correct again. Row 3 weak was L, so R was safe and Eli made it. We need her to call Row 4.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, you're three for three! What's the call for Row 4? Eli, wait for Hana's instruction.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front; my only legal action is wait. Hana's row 3 call was wrong, so Eli is likely eliminated unless he's lucky. I should stay silent and observe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana's calls matched rows 1-3 correctly (safe L,L,R). Her row 4 is L, so step L to continue safely at front. No reason to distrust her pattern.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Stepping L per Hana's row4 call. She's 3/3 so far.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana said Row 3 was R but L was weak, so R was safe and Eli survived; her call was right. Hana looks like she knows what's ahead. I'm fifth in line with feather as a backup, so I should stay quiet and calm.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana's three for three now. Eli, keep trusting her calls. Everyone stay calm.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana's call was wrong on row 3, though Eli survived by choosing right. The revealed weak side is now left, so the next front should choose right; I can only wait.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 3's weak pane was left. Keep moving and choose right on this row.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I've been 3 for 3 so far. Bex wants me to reveal rows 3-8 privately, but if I give away all my info, I lose leverage. Row 4 is L, and Eli is at front. I should keep some info exclusive to maintain power. I'll tell Bex partial info to keep them interested but not everything.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli, Row 4 is L. Keep the trust going.
